summary: All 66 task-02 Playwright cases passed in Chromium, including RO/EN desktop width and metadata stress checks, keyboard and pointer access, mobile collapse, resize transitions, and new real-click checks on both ends of the English save strip at 360 and 1024px. Root npm test discovers the suite; node tests/verify.js and the gdsync, wbsaveall, task-01 row, and task-03 button regression suites passed. No product bug was reproduced. The required test commit is blocked: git add -A failed with 'Unable to create .git/index.lock: Read-only file system', so no commit was created; the test, report, and note changes remain in the working tree. Save and sync effects were intercepted by test spies; no live Drive or folder operation was attempted.
